opus.problem: Almost nothing in the Bible is said about Gomorrah apart from Sodom. Clues 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 fit Sodom just as well, and Sodom is the more obvious guess. Only clues 4 (Birsha) and 7 (Ammonites) separate the two, and both are small details. There are not 7 different facts that point to this word, so the swap-for-a-spare rule applies.
'The morning after its fall' does not match the text. The destruction came after sunrise (Genesis 19:23-24), and Abraham looked out early that same morning (19:27), not the morning after.
